notes.title: SECRET CHRISTMAS UPDATE
notes.content:
Way back in November of 2023, I made a secret "Jingle Jam" edition for the annual Yogscast charity drive. However, they didn't end up playing it. So here's how you can access it for yourself!

Open the properties for VERY SCARY BACKROOMS GAME in your library.
Go into the beta tab.
Type in the code:
YOGSJINGLECATS
and select the new beta option that appears entitled "jingle - Jinglecats edition for YOGS"

Enjoy!

P.S. Accidentally set this event to the 10th of December and now I can't change it, but you can access this build at any time.

notes.title: EPIC NEW GAME ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
[h3]My new game, Moaisland, is coming out [b]today[/b] at 6PM (GMT).[/h3]

[h3]While it's not backrooms themed, it has a similar feeling to VSBG and it's 100% free. A mix of mystery, comedy and general uneasiness. Maybe even the occasional fourth wall break.

I've been working on it for quite a while now and it's weird to see it finally finished. I really hope you enjoy it. [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861280/Moaisland/
